assertions.description: The HTMLImageElement interface the API extends is exposed on the global object.

HTMLImageElement.prototype exposes the replacedByUserAgent member (requires a build containing the UAImageReplacementAPI implementation with --enable-blink-features=UAImageReplacementAPI or an origin-trial token).
replacedByUserAgent is a readonly IDL attribute: an accessor property with a getter and no setter.
HTMLImageElement.prototype exposes the onuareplacestart event handler attribute as an accessor with both getter and setter.
assertions.test: (()=>{if(typeof HTMLImageElement==='undefined')return false;const d=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLImageElement.prototype,'onuareplacestart');return !!d && typeof d.get==='function' && typeof d.set==='function';})()

assertions.description: HTMLImageElement.prototype exposes the onuareplaceend event handler attribute as an accessor with both getter and setter.
assertions.test: (()=>{if(typeof HTMLImageElement==='undefined')return false;const d=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLImageElement.prototype,'onuareplaceend');return !!d && typeof d.get==='function' && typeof d.set==='function';})()

assertions.description: A freshly created, never-replaced image reports replacedByUserAgent === false (the author's content is showing).
uareplacestart fires on the image element when the user agent begins substituting its content, and uareplaceend fires when substitution finishes, fails, or is reverted.
assertions.test: Requires a user-invoked browser replacement feature (e.g. virtual try-on) on a build with UAImageReplacementAPI enabled: trigger a replacement from browser UI and verify uareplacestart fires, replacedByUserAgent flips to true while substitute content shows, and uareplaceend fires with the property back to false when reverted.

assertions.description: Anti-fingerprinting: the events never fire and the property never reads true without an actual replacement initiated by explicit user intent — pages cannot probe for replacement capabilities by observing side effects.
assertions.test: Requires a build with the feature enabled: load a page that attaches listeners and polls replacedByUserAgent without the user invoking any replacement feature, and verify no event fires and every read stays false across the session.
